units.source_text: 爬到山巅，舞女把鼓放在枯草丛中的凳子上，用手巾擦了一把汗。

en.t: When we reached the mountaintop, the dancing girl set her drum on a stool among the withered grass and wiped away her sweat with a towel.

units.source_text: 她似乎要掸掉自己脚上的尘土，却冷不防地蹲在我跟前，替我抖了抖裙裤下摆。

en.t: She seemed about to brush the dust from her own feet, but suddenly crouched down in front of me and shook the dust from the hem of my skirt-trousers.

units.source_text: 舞女不由自主地跪在地上，索性弯着身子给我掸去身上的尘土，然后将撩起的衣服下摆放下，对站着直喘粗气的我说：

en.t: The dancing girl instinctively knelt on the ground, then simply bent over and brushed the dust from my clothes; after lowering the hem she had lifted, she said to me as I stood there breathing hard:
